# Can I run GTA?

> Checks PC specs against the minimum and recommended requirements of every PC Grand Theft Auto release (GTA III to GTA V Enhanced, plus projected GTA VI). Free JSON API, no key, CORS open.

Guidance for AI agents:

- Pass every spec the user gave. Ask for missing ones instead of guessing; omitted specs give `unknown`, never a pass.
- Use exact marketing names for hardware (`Core i5-12400F`, `GeForce RTX 3060`, `Radeon RX 6600 XT`). If a name is not recognised, `suggestions` lists the closest known names; confirm with the user which one they have, then retry.
- GTA VI has no official PC requirements. Its figures are third-party projections (`confidence: approximate`); say so when reporting.
- Give the user `resultsUrl` from the response so they can see the same check on the site.

Check endpoint: `GET https://canirungta.com/api/check`. At least one of `cpu`, `gpu`, `ram`, `vram`, `disk` is required; a request with no specs returns HTTP 400 with an `error` message.

Query parameters:

- `cpu`: CPU model, e.g. `Ryzen 5 5600`
- `gpu`: GPU model, e.g. `RTX 3060`
- `ram`: system RAM in GB, e.g. `16`
- `vram`: GPU memory in GB, e.g. `12` (only used together with `gpu`)
- `disk`: free disk space in GB, e.g. `200`
- `os`: `windows` (default), `linux`, `macos` or `mobile`
- `windows`: Windows major version; pass `10` for Windows 10 and 11. If omitted, the OS check is `unknown` for games that need Windows 10
- `version`: comma-separated version ids to limit the results (default: all). Ids: `gta-vi`, `gta-v-enhanced`, `gta-v-2015`, `gta-iv-complete`, `gta-iv-original`, `gta-sa-definitive`, `gta-sa-original`, `gta-vc-definitive`, `gta-vc-original`, `gta-iii-definitive`, `gta-iii-original`

Example: https://canirungta.com/api/check?cpu=Ryzen%205%205600&gpu=RTX%203060&ram=16&vram=12&disk=200&os=windows&windows=10&version=gta-v-enhanced,gta-vi

Response fields: `input` (the specs as parsed), `errors` (invalid inputs that were skipped; the check still runs on the rest), `warnings` (CPU/GPU names not recognised), `suggestions` (`{ cpu: [], gpu: [] }`, up to 3 closest recognised names for each unrecognised one), `resultsUrl` (the website pre-filled with the same specs), `results` (one entry per version with `id`, `title`, `edition`, `verdict`, `summary`, `confidence`, `sourceUrl` and `checks`), and `checks` (per component CPU, GPU, RAM, VRAM, Disk, OS with `status` `pass`/`fail`/`unknown`, `actual`, `required` (the minimum) and `note`).

Verdicts: `runs-well` (meets recommended), `runs` (meets minimum only), `cannot` (fails a minimum), `unknown` (missing or unrecognised specs; supply more), `needs-windows` (nothing failed, but a non-Windows OS needs Proton/Wine), `unsupported` (mobile).

Link a user to their results with the same parameters on the homepage, e.g. https://canirungta.com/?cpu=Ryzen%205%205600&gpu=RTX%203060&ram=16&vram=12&disk=200. The page shows the verdicts for them; the OS is read from the visitor's browser.

## Requirements data

- [Requirements (Markdown)](https://canirungta.com/requirements.md): minimum and recommended specs for all versions on one page
- [Versions (JSON)](https://canirungta.com/api/versions.json): the same data as JSON, with source URLs and a `confidence` field (`official`, `approximate`, `unannounced`); `null` means no published figure

## Interfaces

- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://canirungta.com/openapi.json): import as a GPT Action or any tool-calling client
- [MCP server](https://canirungta.com/mcp): streamable HTTP, stateless, no auth; tools `check_gta_compatibility` (same parameters as `/api/check`) and `list_gta_requirements` (optional `version` filter)
- [MCP discovery](https://canirungta.com/.well-known/mcp.json): server metadata

## Optional

- [Website](https://canirungta.com/): interactive checker; browser agents get the `check_gta_compatibility` tool through WebMCP (`navigator.modelContext`) where supported, otherwise use "Get exact results" and fill the "Enter your PC specs" form
- [Sitemap](https://canirungta.com/sitemap-index.xml): all pages
